titleEn: Horsch enters into partnership with application map specialist
titleZh: Horsch入股精准施药地图公司Sam-Dimension，深化AI植保合作
summaryZh: 德国农机巨头Horsch战略入股应用地图专家Sam-Dimension，该公司利用无人机搭载高分辨率相机（1毫米精度）和AI系统生成精准施药地图，实现杂草定点喷洒，作业效率达60公顷/小时。双方自2019年起已合作，该技术适用于洋葱、马铃薯、胡萝卜、甜菜等多种作物，并兼容多家主流品牌喷雾机。此举标志着农机与AI植保技术的深度融合，为智慧农业精准施药提供了可落地的解决方案。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了农机巨头与AI植保技术公司的深度绑定，其高精度无人机+AI施药地图方案对智慧种植业（尤其是大田作物）的精准植保具有直接参考价值，也体现了传感器与自动化技术在农业中的前沿应用趋势。

Horsch enters into partnership with application map specialist

 24-06 | Smart farming | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Machinery manufacturer Horsch has taken a strategic stake in the German application map specialist Sam-Dimension. Photo: Horsch

Machinery manufacturer Horsch has taken a strategic stake in the German company Sam-Dimension. Sam-Dimension specialises in supplying application maps created using drone imagery for spot spraying against weeds. The 2 companies have already been working together since 2019.

Sam-Dimension has developed a special camera with a resolution of 1 millimetre, according to the specialist itself. Using these camera images, Sam-Dimension’s AI system, Sam-Cam AI, creates an application map that can be loaded into a field sprayer to turn it into a spot sprayer. According to Sam-Dimension, its system has a capacity of 60 hectares per hour.

Many different crops

Sam-Dimension’s system works in a large number of crops, such as onions, potatoes, carrots and beet, and for green-on-brown applications. The application maps can be used on any field sprayer with GPS-controlled section control. In addition to Horsch, Sam-Dimension’s application maps also work with sprayers from Amazone, John Deere, Hardi and Agrifac, among others.

translationZh:
机械制造商Horsch已对德国公司Sam-Dimension进行战略入股。Sam-Dimension专注于提供利用无人机影像生成的施药地图，用于杂草的定点喷洒。这两家公司自2019年以来一直保持合作。

据该公司介绍，Sam-Dimension开发了一款分辨率高达1毫米的特殊相机。利用这些相机图像，Sam-Dimension的AI系统“Sam-Cam AI”会生成一张施药地图，可加载到田间喷雾机上，使其转变为定点喷雾机。据Sam-Dimension称，其系统的作业能力为每小时60公顷。

**适用于多种作物**

Sam-Dimension的系统适用于大量作物，例如洋葱、马铃薯、胡萝卜和甜菜，以及“绿色对棕色”（即作物与土壤背景）的施药场景。这些施药地图可用于任何配备GPS控制分区功能的田间喷雾机。除了Horsch，Sam-Dimension的施药地图也兼容Amazone、John Deere、Hardi和Agrifac等品牌的喷雾机。
